title: A text report table
description:
Format rows of data as an aligned table.

```
| Name   | Score | Grade |
|--------|------:|-------|
| Ada    |    91 | A     |
| Bob    |     8 | F     |
| Céline |    77 | B     |
```
hints: `string.format("%-6s", s)` pads by bytes, which is wrong for `é`; pad yourself with `s .. string.rep(" ", width - utf8.len(s))` (lesson 4.05).
`type(value) == "number"` decides the alignment; build each line with `table.concat(cells, " | ")`.
requirements: Column widths come from the longest value in each column (including the header).
Count characters with `utf8.len`, so `Céline` lines up.
stretch: Add a total row under the table.
